categoryDefinitions.Cells: Individual eukaryotic cells and recognizable cell states; multicellular tissue assemblies belong in Tissues & models.
categoryDefinitions.Cell structures: Organelles, cytoskeleton, intracellular vesicles and isolated subcellular structures; membrane junctions have a separate category.
categoryDefinitions.Membranes & junctions: Bilayers, membrane domains, cell contacts and protrusions; isolated receptor proteins belong in Proteins & complexes.
categoryDefinitions.Proteins & complexes: Proteins, antibodies, receptors, enzymes and protein-dominated molecular assemblies.
categoryDefinitions.Nucleic acids: DNA, RNA, chromosomes and nucleic-acid-dominated molecular structures.
categoryDefinitions.Molecules & particles: Small molecules, lipids, polymers, nanoparticles and free assay beads; proteins and nucleic acids have separate categories.
categoryDefinitions.Tissues & models: Tissue microanatomy, extracellular matrix, organoids, spheroids and tissue engineering constructs.
categoryDefinitions.Organs & anatomy: Whole organs and macroscopic anatomical structures; cellular and histological sections belong in Tissues & models.
categoryDefinitions.Viruses: Virions, viral components and virus-centered entry or budding assemblies.
categoryDefinitions.Bacteria & archaea: Prokaryotic cells, communities and prokaryotic structures.
categoryDefinitions.Fungi & protists: Fungi and non-helminth protists; parasite-specific specimens are filed in Parasites.
categoryDefinitions.Parasites: Protozoan or helminth parasites, their stages and infection-specific specimens.
categoryDefinitions.Plants: Whole plants, plant organs and plant-specific cells or structures.
categoryDefinitions.Development & embryos: Fertilization and embryonic stages, including embryo-specific sections.
categoryDefinitions.Animals: Whole model animals and animal-specific life stages other than embryos.
categoryDefinitions.Labware & consumables: Containers, pipettes, tips, plates, slides, filters and passive disposable laboratory tools.
categoryDefinitions.Instruments: Active laboratory measurement, processing and automation instruments; microscopy and culture equipment have separate categories.
categoryDefinitions.Microscopy & imaging: Microscopes, imaging systems and their dedicated optical or imaging accessories.
categoryDefinitions.Culture & microfluidics: Culture chambers, bioreactors, chips and microfluidic hardware; living models belong in Tissues & models.
categoryDefinitions.Lab infrastructure & safety: Storage, cold chain, containment, sterilization, protective clothing and safety infrastructure.
categoryDefinitions.Animal & clinical equipment: Animal handling, surgery, administration and clinical sample-collection equipment.
categoryDefinitions.Experimental assemblies: Multi-part assay complexes, experimental preparations and readout schematics that do not represent one standalone object.
